summary.value: Lowers the Housing Code's minimum ceiling height in existing buildings to seven feet for habitable rooms and six feet eight inches for other rooms.

citations.quote: Ordinance amending the Housing Code to reduce the minimum ceiling height for habitable rooms in existing buildings to seven feet and other rooms to six feet eight inches; and affirming the Planning Department’s determination under the California Environmental Quality Act.
[Housing Code - Ceiling Heights] 260623 Sponsors: Wong; Dorsey, Sherrill, Sauter, Melgar, Mahmood, Chen and Mandelman
